trigger: a service crash-loops during the soak; docker keeps .State.Running true while it restarts the container, so `qa-stack.sh running` reads 4/4
classification_rationale: the soak reports every service running over a crash loop; the check it replaced read .State.Status, so this is a regression
summary: Reproduced with a throwaway container exiting every second. B1. Fixed in f863871ba (count .State.Status == running, restart count against a baseline); the baseline itself was tightened to 'must be 0' in 5c7a45cb8 (see qaharness-restart-baseline-absorbs-crash).

trigger: an agent drops mid-soak (or right after registering); yuzu_agents_registered_total never decreases, so the soak and the integration 'Agent registered' check still see >= 1
classification_rationale: presence read from a cumulative counter; the live gauges existed and were unused
summary: Also unhappy-path (each crash-and-re-register looks healthier). B2. Fixed in f863871ba: server yuzu_agents_connected in the soak, integration and wait_agent. The between-samples reconnect gap this left was raised in pass 2 (qaharness-soak-misses-reconnect-between-samples).

trigger: every soak sample POSTs {plugin: status, action: ping}; the status plugin has no ping action and the response goes to /dev/null with || true
classification_rationale: the soak claims to exercise the data path and never observes a result
summary: Also unhappy-path. B3. Fixed in f863871ba: a real status.health round-trip about once a minute, bounded at 20s, counted; the soak fails if any fails or none succeeds. Run 36643275837 showed 10 of 10 round-trips.

trigger: the agent drops moments after registering; the integration 'Gateway sees agent' step reads the cumulative yuzu_gw_agents_connected_total
classification_rationale: cumulative counter used where the gauge yuzu_gw_agents_current exists
summary: B4. Fixed in f863871ba (gauge). The gauge is refreshed on a 10s timer, so a single read failed falsely in run 36642941518; bb3cd4cfc polls it for up to 30s (wait-metric).

trigger: silent uninstall on windows-2022: unins000.exe exits as soon as it relaunches itself from %TEMP% as _unins.tmp, which then waits on an unsuppressed MsgBox; the bounded poll saw the binary gone and printed PASS
classification_rationale: run 36641096129 printed 'PASS: uninstalled cleanly' at 2.4s while _unins.tmp was still alive at job end; the step comment's 'lingering child' was the uninstaller itself
summary: Also unhappy-path (the handoff makes the 3-minute check dead). B5. Fixed in f863871ba: done means no unins000/_unins*/_iu* process, the {AppId}_is1 Uninstall key gone and the binary gone; a timeout names what is left and kills it. Run 36643275837 then failed honestly after 3 minutes naming _unins.tmp. The MsgBox root cause is qaharness-silent-uninstall-msgbox.

trigger: QA runs against a tag whose reference template differs from the checkout's (v0.14.0-rc2 differs by this branch's --plugin-dir fix): qa-stack.sh takes the gateway sys.config from the tag but the compose template from the checkout
classification_rationale: a QA run can pass on a template the release does not ship
summary: Reporter's own call was MEDIUM; I3 derives HIGH. Also release-deploy (NICE). B6. Fixed in f863871ba: the tag's template is fetched and diffed against the checkout's, drift printed as ::warning:: and in the job summary; the checkout's template still runs because v0.13.0's names a never-published image. Drift line count corrected in 5c7a45cb8.

trigger: an upgrade that loses the agent's issued certificate (the 10-use enrollment token lets it re-enrol) or leaves it loading 0 plugins; the upgrade test only checks that some agent registered and sends no command afterwards
classification_rationale: the upgrade test reports PASS over outcomes it cannot observe
summary: Also unhappy-path (MEDIUM) and gateway-erlang (NICE). Reporters called it should-fix; I3 derives HIGH. S1. Fixed in f863871ba: agent id captured before and required after, on the new version, plus an os_info round-trip; the job comment says what it does not cover. Restart and state checks after the upgrade added in 5c7a45cb8. Not yet exercised in CI (qaharness-upgrade-path-never-exercised).

trigger: a real fleet upgrades the server (and gateway) first and keeps older agents until they self-update; the upgrade test moves all four images at once
classification_rationale: missing coverage of the documented operator procedure; bounded blast radius
summary: unhappy-path also noted the test starts v0.13.0 on the new compose file rather than the one v0.13.0 shipped. The job comment now states it is not a mixed-version test (f863871ba).

trigger: a maintainer follows the healthcheck KEEP IN SYNC lists, which still name pre-release.yml heredocs this diff deletes
classification_rationale: stale inventory in docs/ci-architecture.md, verify-healthcheck-invariants.sh:30 and docker-healthcheck-invariants.yml:125; the gate itself stays consistent
summary: Also consistency-auditor (LOW). Reporter's SHOULD disagrees with the derivation: nothing is checked wrongly (the reference template is already covered by the deploy/docker pattern), so I9 derives INFO. S2. Fixed in 0d872ad01.

trigger: an operator reads the #5134 fragment/template comment: 'searched beside its binary' and 'No plugin found'
classification_rationale: the default is <exe_dir>/../plugins and operators see REJECTED 'plugin not found: <name>'; the remedy given is still right
summary: Also release-deploy (NICE). S3. Fixed in 0d872ad01 (fragment and template comment).

trigger: a version string containing a newline reaches set_env's sed and the tag URLs
classification_rationale: defence in depth: the release lookup must succeed, git tag names cannot hold a newline, and only repo writers can dispatch
summary: Confirmed on a copy of the helper. S4. Fixed in f863871ba (version shape validated; values sed would interpret refused). The tag's shape before GITHUB_OUTPUT was pass 3's qaharness-tag-to-github-output-unchecked.

trigger: the tagged sys.config fetch uses curl -L, which follows a redirect to plain HTTP
classification_rationale: defence in depth on a fetch from the release tag
summary: S5. Fixed in f863871ba: --proto '=https', --max-time 60, and a 404 told apart from other failures. pass-2 security-guardian verified an HTTPS->HTTP redirect is refused.

trigger: a server that accepts connections and never answers; the wait loops' curl calls have no --max-time
classification_rationale: only the job timeout bounds a hung request; the job still fails
summary: S5. Fixed in f863871ba (--max-time on every curl); pass 2 found the iteration-counted loops then overran (qaharness-wait-loops-count-iterations).

trigger: a gateway relx release version bump: the sys.config mount target releases/0.2.0 silently stops matching and the gateway boots its built-in config
classification_rationale: a false red, never a false green (QA fails loudly)
summary: Also build-ci and unhappy-path. S6. f863871ba read the target from the tagged template but took the first match; security-guardian, build-ci, release-deploy, gateway-erlang, unhappy-path and consistency-auditor re-raised that in pass 2, and 5c7a45cb8 requires exactly one. gateway-erlang (pass 3) noted the same path named twice would false-red; 031f675c5 counts distinct paths.

trigger: a maintainer reads the pre-release.yml header saying every image job uses the computed REGISTRY; the stack jobs now pull the template's hardcoded ghcr.io/devnullltd
classification_rationale: stale comment; the two sources agree today
summary: Also consistency-auditor and unhappy-path. S7. Fixed in f863871ba (header says which jobs use REGISTRY and why the stack jobs do not).

trigger: the workflow runs from a fork or a moved repo; qa-stack.sh fetches tagged files from the hardcoded DevNullLtd/Yuzu
classification_rationale: wrong source repo for tagged files
summary: S7. Fixed in f863871ba: QA_REPO is ${{ github.repository }}.

trigger: login fails without setting a session; `grep -q .` on the cookie jar always matches curl's Netscape header line
classification_rationale: a failed login still fails loudly later, with a misleading cause
summary: Also unhappy-path (confirmed curl writes the file with no cookie). S8. Fixed in f863871ba: requires a yuzu_session cookie. The password moved off argv in 031f675c5 (qaharness-login-password-in-argv).

trigger: shellcheck on qa-stack.sh
classification_rationale: unused loop variable only
summary: S9. Fixed in f863871ba.

trigger: ARM64 artifacts return under a name other than yuzu-linux-arm64.tar.gz; the check prints SKIP and stays green
classification_rationale: the ARM64 archive check can become permanently unreachable without anyone seeing it
summary: S10. Fixed in f863871ba: a missing ARM64 archive is a ::warning:: and a summary line.

trigger: a brief GHCR hiccup during compose pull
classification_rationale: flaky red only
summary: S11. Fixed in f863871ba (bounded retry).

trigger: `compose up -d` itself fails; set -e exits before any service state or log reaches the step log
classification_rationale: diagnostics only in the uploaded artifact
summary: S12. Fixed in f863871ba (dump ps and recent logs to stderr).

trigger: every bounded wait in the upgrade job runs to its limit; the sum exceeds the 20-minute job timeout
classification_rationale: the job is cancelled instead of failing with its own message; still red
summary: S12. f863871ba raised it to 30 min; after the loops became wall-clock bounded the budget was written into qa-stack.sh and recomputed in 5c7a45cb8 and again in 031f675c5 (45/60/75 min), which pass-4 build-ci re-added and confirmed.

trigger: QA dispatched against a tag older than the newest stable (e.g. re-testing an rc of an older line): the previous-release pick is 'newest release that is not this tag', so the run downgrades and labels it an upgrade
classification_rationale: the upgrade result can describe a downgrade
summary: Reporter's NICE disagrees with the derivation; I3 derives HIGH. unhappy-path re-raised it in pass 2 (UP-G8-5). Fixed in da8946ca3 (#5150): highest non-draft, non-prerelease vX.Y.Z strictly below the tag (sort -V); a failed gh release list fails resolve. pass-3 consistency-auditor checked v0.14.0-rc3 picks v0.13.0.

trigger: a release missing a .deb/.rpm/.pkg, or a macOS pkg with 0 plugins: install-deb/install-rpm print SKIP and continue, install-macos exits 0 on SKIP and prints 'PASS: 0 plugins installed'
classification_rationale: install jobs go green having installed nothing
summary: Also release-deploy (NICE). Reporters called it low/nice as pre-existing; I3 derives HIGH. Re-raised in pass 2 by cross-platform (derived HIGH) and happy-path. Fixed in e077394af (#5151): exactly one package each or fail, the packages must run, macOS needs >= 5 plugins. Missing images: qaharness-missing-image-skips.

trigger: running the manual sanitizer UAT rig: docker-compose.sanitizer-uat.yml's agent has no --plugin-dir (and its server no --data-dir), so it loads 0 plugins and sanitizer-uat.sh's commands only reach the not-found path while the run reports sanitizer-clean
classification_rationale: same defect class as this branch's template fix, in a dev rig outside this diff
summary: Also release-deploy. Pre-existing manual dev rig, not touched here; reporters recommended a follow-up issue rather than blocking the hotfix. Filed as #5148 (2026-09-29).

trigger: any /VERYSILENT /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES agent uninstall (SCCM, Intune, GPO): the usPostUninstall 'Remove agent data directory?' prompt is a plain MsgBox, which /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES does not suppress
classification_rationale: product bug behind qaharness-windows-uninstall-false-pass; the installer is not this branch's to edit
summary: The reporter graded the harness symptom (HIGH), not the product hang, which derives I5 MEDIUM. Fixed in the separate packaging hotfix, PR #5160 (#5147), which owns yuzu-agent.iss; release-deploy (pass 2) confirmed the silent uninstall skips the dialog from rc3.

trigger: a pre-existing security-relevant default in the operator reference compose template (details in a private security advisory)
classification_rationale: pre-existing (not introduced or touched by this diff); tracked privately
summary: Also gateway-erlang. Reported privately to the maintainers as a security advisory by operator decision (2026-09-30); fix to follow through the advisory. This diff does not change the relevant lines.

trigger: QA's command round-trip exercises the :50063 mgmt plane, but nothing in QA proves another caller is refused
classification_rationale: negative test not in the release smoke
summary: Rejected: the #1422 peer pin's refusal is covered by the gateway's own tests (yuzu_gw_authz_rpc_tests, yuzu_gw_mtls_tests, yuzu_gw_config_posture_tests); the QA stack mounts the release's own strict sys.config. The companion 're-run a command after upgrade' is fixed under qaharness-upgrade-asserts-too-little.

trigger: two QA stacks on one host collide on the template's fixed container names and host ports
classification_rationale: cannot happen on fresh GitHub-hosted runners
summary: Also unhappy-path. Rejected: the stack jobs run on fresh GitHub-hosted runners and the per-job project name separates volumes and networks; changing the operator template's names for CI would drift from what operators run.

trigger: reader of fc1a8f2e3's message: the step also adds /NORESTART
classification_rationale: commit message incomplete
summary: Rejected: commits are not rewritten (new commits only); f863871ba's message and the step comment describe the flags.

trigger: the 'did not report ready within 180s' error does not name the endpoint it probed
classification_rationale: error wording
summary: Rejected: the message names the service and its bound, and the probe is on the adjacent lines; the waits were reworked to wall-clock deadlines in 5c7a45cb8.

trigger: artifact-verify compares a pre-release .deb's control Version (0.14.0~rc3) with the tag spelling and warns on every RC
classification_rationale: comparison noise; split here from the rc3 packaging ledger (rc3pkg-artifact-verify-deb-version-warn)
summary: Fixed in b4fac1e48 (compare with the tag's first '-' as '~'). Making a mismatch fail is qaharness-deb-version-only-warns.

trigger: a DNS failure, TLS error, timeout or 429/5xx while `has-stack` probes the previous release: it exits 1, the same code as 'predates the reference stack', and prevstack records tested=false
classification_rationale: a GitHub outage drops a real upgrade test and the report says NOT TESTED (predates) with Result PASSED; contradicts the script's own comment
summary: Also build-ci (G8-BC-1, fake curl) and unhappy-path (UP-G8-1, reproduced). Fixed in 5c7a45cb8: 'predates' exits 3, any fetch failure 1, the step cases on it. pass-3 security-guardian, consistency-auditor and unhappy-path re-ran shims: only a real 404 reads NOT TESTED.

trigger: the agent's stream drops and reconnects (about 2s) between two ~40s gauge samples; the soak ends with 0 degraded samples
classification_rationale: sampled gauge cannot see a sub-interval reconnect
summary: Reporter's own call was MEDIUM; I3 derives HIGH. Fixed in 5c7a45cb8: baselines yuzu_agents_registered_total and yuzu_gw_agents_connected_total at soak start and fails on any change; 031f675c5 waits for the gateway stream before the baseline and distinguishes a gateway replay in the message.

trigger: a container crashes once during startup: the soak's restart baseline absorbs it and prints 'no container restarts'; integration and the post-upgrade verify never check restarts
classification_rationale: a crash before the soak starts is invisible to every stack job
summary: Also sre (G6-4, LOW, upgrade verify). Reporters' labels disagree with the I3 derivation (HIGH). Fixed in 5c7a45cb8: `check-stable` requires every service running with 0 restarts at soak start, at the end of integration and after the upgrade.

trigger: a server that accepts connections and never answers: 60 tries x up to 30s curl makes one wait about 33 minutes, past the job timeout, and the 'within 180s' messages are false
classification_rationale: still red, but the stack dump never runs
summary: Also unhappy-path (UP-G8-4). Fixed in 5c7a45cb8: every wait is driven by a $SECONDS deadline, probes capped at 10s, budget written into the header.

trigger: integration fails; the report's upgrade cell says 'no previous stable release'
classification_rationale: wrong stated cause; overall result still FAILED
summary: UP-G8-6. Fixed in da8946ca3: the cell names the real cause (no previous stable, predates, integration failed/skipped, no result).

trigger: install-deb on debian:12 or ubuntu:22.04: the v0.13.0 .deb installs but `yuzu-agent --version` fails with GLIBC_2.38 not found; the job never runs the binary
classification_rationale: install legs green where the product cannot run
summary: Verified in throwaway containers. Item 18. Fixed in e077394af: server and agent run --version, the gateway release must boot; a GLIBC/GLIBCXX not-found names #5143. The gateway leg's boot check was itself a false pass (qaharness-gateway-install-check-never-starts).

trigger: install-rpm on fedora:40: its libstdc++ lacks GLIBCXX_3.4.34, which the GCC 15 build needs, so the leg is red whatever #5142 fixed
classification_rationale: a leg that can never pass tests nothing
summary: Item 19. Fixed in e077394af: fedora:42 via `dnf install` of the file; rockylinux:9 stays and fails honestly on #5143.

trigger: installing the release's Linux packages on ubuntu:22.04, debian:12, rockylinux:9 (and the ubuntu:24.04 server): the binaries need glibc 2.38 and GCC 15's libstdc++
classification_rationale: product/release floor, not a harness defect; QA now reports these legs red
summary: Intended reds, listed in the workflow and docs/ci-architecture.md (936cec538, e57bd39e9). pass-4 release-deploy confirmed on rc2 and rc3 packages.

trigger: a .deb whose control Version differs from the tag: artifact-verify only warns and stays green
classification_rationale: after PR #5160's packaging a mismatch cannot reach a published release
summary: Also consistency-auditor (C2, would have called it medium). E6 caps at LOW. Item 6. Fixed in e077394af: a mismatch fails; the comment says the tag spelling is in the file name only from PR #5160 on.

trigger: a release missing one of its images: artifact-verify and the Trivy scan print SKIP and pass
classification_rationale: a release missing an image reads as inspected and cleanly scanned
summary: Reporter's pre-existing LOW disagrees with the I3 derivation (HIGH). Same false-green class as #5151. Fixed in e37ad0b00: retry once, then fail naming the image. pass-3 build-ci and consistency-auditor then found the docs still said the scan never fails (qaharness-security-scan-doc-never-fails).

trigger: the TLS-pass service never stops: the uninstaller deletes the logs folder before anything copies the agent log
classification_rationale: the diagnostic that pass exists for is lost; the job still fails
summary: Item 15. Fixed in e077394af (collect before uninstall, always()). The guard then saved pass 1's log under the TLS name (qaharness-windows-tls-log-wrong-pass).

trigger: a future release lengthens telemetry_gauge_interval_ms past about 25s; the 30s gateway-gauge wait fails while the gateway holds the agent
classification_rationale: false red only
summary: Rejected: the harness mounts the release's own reference sys.config, which sets 10s; a change there would fail loudly and the wait is one argument to adjust.

trigger: every QA run so far resolved v0.12.0 (predates the stack) as the previous release, so the upgrade job took the NOT TESTED path
classification_rationale: the same-agent-id, version and post-upgrade round-trip checks rest on code reading only
summary: Also build-ci, release-deploy, gateway-erlang, unhappy-path and consistency-auditor (security-guardian noted it outside its domain). rc2 stops at resolve on #5141; the rc3 run 36693802178 skipped the upgrade because integration is red on the gateway /metrics 500. First real run needs a tag whose integration passes. Reporters did not grade it; I6 derives MEDIUM.

trigger: the QA report prints 'Result: PASSED' while a suite cell says NOT TESTED or SKIP
classification_rationale: the per-suite cells are labelled honestly, so the reader can tell
summary: Also consistency-auditor (C3, INFO: disclosed, not a false green). Reporter's MEDIUM disagrees with the I8 derivation (LOW). Item 4. Fixed in da8946ca3: PASSED only when every suite ran and passed, else 'PASSED WITH GAPS (<n> not tested)'; failures and cancellations stay FAILED.

trigger: an auditor looks for QA evidence after 3 days (logs) or 7 days (Trivy)
classification_rationale: no durable result record beyond the job summary
summary: Reporter's MEDIUM disagrees with the I8 derivation (LOW): the evidence is correct, it expires. Item 13. Raised to 30 days in 5c7a45cb8/e077394af; pass-3 compliance-officer asked for 90 to match docs/ci-architecture.md, done in 031f675c5 and c6630202b (qaharness-evidence-retention-30-vs-90).

trigger: Pre-release QA runs after the release is published, so a release can ship while QA is red
classification_rationale: by design; not new in this hotfix
summary: Reporter's MEDIUM (carried in the risk register, pass 3) disagrees with the I8 derivation (LOW). Rejected: QA is detective by design, documented in docs/ci-architecture.md 'Pre-release QA' (ea53c89e4: it starts after the release is published and never blocks one). Release gating is release.yml's job.

trigger: an auditor traces #5135/#5142/#5144/#5147/#5145 to committed artifacts; only #5134 has a fragment
classification_rationale: traceability gap; the CI-only changes are not operator-visible so no fragment is mandated
summary: Reporter's MEDIUM disagrees with the I8 derivation (LOW). Fixed in ea53c89e4: docs/ci-architecture.md and workflow comments cite #5134, #5135, #5142-#5145, #5147, #5150, #5151, #1468 (pass-3 compliance-officer confirmed).

trigger: a slow leak that stays under the container limit through the 10-minute soak
classification_rationale: memory recorded, never asserted; bounded-blast-radius missing check
summary: Item 11. Fixed in 5c7a45cb8: a service that more than doubles warns and the summary labels memory informational; 031f675c5 moved the baseline past warm-up (qaharness-memory-warning-every-soak).

trigger: a benign 'panic' string in Postgres' log fails the soak; an Erlang supervisor crash report (no container restart) is not matched
classification_rationale: combined-log grep across all four services
summary: Item 12. Fixed in 5c7a45cb8 (per-service, Postgres skipped, gateway OTP report patterns). Those patterns never matched OTP 28's format: qaharness-gateway-crash-patterns-never-match.

trigger: a transient /metrics failure or an expired session cookie: metric() returns 0, the same as an absent series, and the soak fails with no hint
classification_rationale: false red with a misleading cause
summary: First raised by unhappy-path in pass 1 (LOW); sre (G6-3) re-raised it. Item 10. Fixed in 5c7a45cb8: re-login and retry once, then 'metric fetch failed' and exit 1.

trigger: the agent's reconnect backoff grows while the upgraded server is down; the post-upgrade agent wait is a fixed 180s
classification_rationale: raised speculative; resolved by reading agents/core/src/agent.cpp:1670-1682 (1<<n seconds, 300s cap)
summary: Rejected: the upgrade recreates the agent with the other services, so its backoff restarts at 1s; a long server outage could only produce a bounded false red, never a false green. Revisit if the first real upgrade run flakes.

trigger: an operator overriding the agent container's command: reads device-management.md, which gives the --plugin-dir default as ./plugins
classification_rationale: user-manual default contradicts main.cpp; a missed flag fails visibly (plugin not found)
summary: Item 17. Fixed in ea53c89e4; the new text was still wrong for the chisel image (qaharness-plugin-dir-default-chisel-image).

trigger: operators on v0.14.0 and earlier copied the template with no --plugin-dir
classification_rationale: the failure is visible (plugin not found)
summary: Rejected: release notes are assembled from changelog.d fragments, and the #5134 fragment already tells operators who copied the template to add the flag.

trigger: a drifted template line whose content starts with - or +
classification_rationale: the warning's count undercounts; the diff is still shown
summary: Item 14. Fixed in 5c7a45cb8.

trigger: a maintainer looks for what Pre-release QA asserts; docs/ci-architecture.md has no section
classification_rationale: CI documentation is not one of the six required-doc categories, so not I7
summary: Item 16. Fixed in ea53c89e4 ('Pre-release QA' section: trigger, detective design, per-job assertions, template/tag sources, NOT TESTED / PASSED WITH GAPS, expected reds).

trigger: a gateway process crashes or a supervised child restarts during the soak: the reference sys.config's logger template has no legacy header, so OTP 28 logs 'crasher: initial call' and 'Supervisor: ... Context: child_terminated', never CRASH REPORT/SUPERVISOR REPORT
classification_rationale: the check can never fire, and pre-release.yml and docs/ci-architecture.md claim it does
summary: Also unhappy-path (UP-R2-1) and gateway-erlang (whose note that the implementer's shim was hand-typed in the old format stands; it was closure evidence for a non-blocking item, so no false-green floor). Reproduced on OTP 28. R2. Fixed in 031f675c5 (OTP 28 crasher/Supervisor Context patterns, legacy kept, bare Supervisor: excluded), checked against real formatter output and 0 matches in run 36686335196's logs; dd32e71c1 matches OTP's actual 'Context: shutdown. Reason: reached_max_restart_intensity'.

trigger: install-deb/install-rpm gateway legs run `yuzu_gw daemon` without the unit's /etc/yuzu/gateway.env: YUZU_GW_COOKIE is unset, yuzu_gw_app refuses to start, but daemon returns and ping answers pong in that window
classification_rationale: the gateway leg prints PASS while the application never started
summary: Also gateway-erlang (reproduced on v0.13.0 / ubuntu:26.04). R1. Fixed in 936cec538: starts it with the unit file's User/WorkingDirectory/Environment/EnvironmentFile, requires the yuzu_gw application running within 30s, still up 10s later, clean stop. pass-4 gateway-erlang and release-deploy re-ran it with the env emptied and with yuzu_gw_sup killed: both fail.

trigger: the soak reads its starting counters before the agent's second (client-certificate) registration reaches the gateway
classification_rationale: occasional false red
summary: Also consistency-auditor. R3. Fixed in 031f675c5 (wait-metric on both gateway metrics first).

trigger: a slow server boot or upgrade migration: `timeout 120` on compose up -d also waits on the server's healthcheck (up to ~310s)
classification_rationale: false red; the header's stated reason was wrong
summary: Also unhappy-path (UP-R2-3). R4. Fixed in 031f675c5 (420s; budget and job timeouts recomputed).

trigger: a reader of docs/ci-architecture.md: the security scan 'never fails the run'
classification_rationale: true only before e37ad0b00
summary: Also consistency-auditor. R5. Fixed in e57bd39e9.

trigger: the --no-tls pass fails before its uninstall: its agent log stays on disk and the TLS-pass collect step saves it as agent-tls.log
classification_rationale: mislabelled diagnostic in an already-failing job
summary: Also cross-platform. R6. Fixed in c6630202b: `if: always() && steps.tls_install.outcome == 'success'`.

trigger: every soak: the server grows from ~24MiB during warm-up to ~125MiB, so the 2x warning always fires
classification_rationale: noise
summary: UP-R2-2. R7. Fixed in 031f675c5 (baseline at the first successful round-trip; summary says so). pass-4 replay on rc2 data: 1.86x, no warning.

trigger: a gateway-to-server call fails and the gateway replays every registration: the soak fails saying an agent dropped
classification_rationale: right verdict, wrong stated cause
summary: Also consistency-auditor. R8. Fixed in 031f675c5.

trigger: an operator of the published agent-chisel image reads the corrected --plugin-dir row, which says a bare-name start resolves against the working directory
classification_rationale: the image starts /usr/local/bin/yuzu-agent by absolute path, so the default is /usr/local/plugins; the advice to restate --plugin-dir is still right
summary: Also consistency-auditor (LOW). Reporter's MEDIUM disagrees with the I8 derivation (LOW): the guidance still leads to the right action and a miss fails visibly. R9. Fixed in e57bd39e9 (pass-4 docs-writer confirmed against main.cpp and Dockerfile.agent.chisel).

trigger: a maintainer reads 'Expected failures on old releases' before rc3's QA: it implies rc3 is clean, and comments blame rockylinux:9/debian:12 on #5143 alone
classification_rationale: rc3's intended reds (#5143 floor; #5171 gateway crypto) were not listed; the fedora:42 gateway failure read as a time-bound overrun
summary: Also cross-platform (F2, LOW). Reporter's MEDIUM disagrees with the I8 derivation (LOW). R10. Fixed in 936cec538 (workflow comments, #5171 named in the failure) and e57bd39e9 (docs); pass-4 release-deploy and cross-platform confirmed the rc3 reds match the list.

trigger: reader of the install-windows comment: the uninstaller 'spends up to 15s polling'
classification_rationale: stale timing comment
summary: D3/R11. Fixed in c6630202b.

trigger: QA evidence kept 30 days against the 90-day retention docs/ci-architecture.md states elsewhere
